LESSON: MEETING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1.5: Meeting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Meeting. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which parents or forms on basic family needs basic family needs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recognize basic needs in the family
2. identify ways in which parents or guardians meets basic family needs 72
3. appreciate the efforts of parents or guardians in meeting family needs. (farming, employment and business) or rhymes on how parents or guardians meet basic family needs.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recognize basic needs in the family
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize basic needs in the family. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify ways in which parents or guardians meets basic family needs 72
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways in which parents or guardians meets basic family needs 72. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the efforts of parents or guardians in meeting family needs. (farming, employment and business) or rhymes on how parents or guardians meet basic family needs.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the efforts of parents or guardians in meeting family needs. (farming, employment and business) or rhymes on how parents or guardians meet basic family needs. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Meeting.
2. Explain Meeting to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Meeting.
4. Show that you can: Recognize basic needs in the family
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Meeting. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: which parents or forms on basic family needs basic family needs?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Recognize basic needs in the family
2. identify ways in which parents or guardians meets basic family needs 72
3. appreciate the efforts of parents or guardians in meeting family needs. (farming, employment and business) or rhymes on how parents or guardians meet basic family needs.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
